description: This file defines the core logic for managing voice and speech recognition modes within an iOS application. It includes handling microphone permissions, starting/stopping speech recognition, managing push-to-talk sessions, processing transcripts, integrating with chat through a gateway, and TTS (Text-to-Speech) playback, including incremental speech features. The class 'TalkModeManager' centralizes the state and behavior for talk modes, speaker recognition, and voice synthesis.

classes.name: StreamFailureBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container for error states related to stream failures, used internally to handle PCM format rejection.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: The main class managing voice recognition, TTS, and chat interaction states and behaviors within the app.

methods.name: attachGateway
methods.description: Attaches a gateway session for chat communication.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins voice recognition and chat subscription if configured and connected.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops voice recognition, chat, and resets state.

methods.name: beginPushToTalk
methods.description: Initiates a push-to-talk session, requesting mic permissions and starting recognition.

methods.name: endPushToTalk
methods.description: Ends a push-to-talk session, processing the transcript and sending chat.

methods.name: runPushToTalkOnce
methods.description: Runs a push-to-talk session for a specified max duration.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Processes and plays the assistant's response, handling TTS and incremental speech.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops any ongoing speech output, including incremental speech.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if the current speech output should be interrupted based on new input.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt for chat based on the transcript and interruption info.
